original_title: 007 First Light Sells 1.5 Million Copies in First 24 Hours, Faster Than Any Hitman Game From IO Interactive
summary_en: IO Interactive's new James Bond adventure, **007 First Light**, has achieved a monumental launch, selling over 1.5 million copies within its first day. This explosive start makes it the fastest-selling title in the developer's history, outpacing even their acclaimed **Hitman** series.
ai_analysis: This sales surge for **007 First Light** highlights the enduring global appeal of the James Bond IP and IO Interactive's proven ability to deliver high-quality gaming experiences that resonate with both new and existing fans.

en.title: 007 First Light Smashes Records, Selling 1.5 Million in 24 Hours
en.summary: IO Interactive's new James Bond adventure, **007 First Light**, has achieved a monumental launch, selling over 1.5 million copies within its first day. This explosive start makes it the fastest-selling title in the developer's history, outpacing even their acclaimed **Hitman** series.
en.body:
The world of espionage gaming has a new king, and his name is Bond. **007 First Light**, the latest venture from Danish developer IO Interactive, has exploded out of the gate, selling an astonishing 1.5 million copies in its initial 24 hours of release. This figure not only marks a personal best for IO Interactive but also signifies a new benchmark, eclipsing the launch-day sales of any title in their beloved **Hitman** franchise.

The game, which officially launched on May 27, 2026, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, casts players as a younger, more raw James Bond navigating the perilous early stages of his MI6 career. This origin story, aiming to capture the essence of Ian Fleming's novels and the iconic film series, has clearly struck a chord with audiences worldwide.

> "The milestone of 1.5 million units sold in 24 hours reflects overwhelming global enthusiasm for **007 First Light** and represents a significant achievement for IO Interactive," the developer stated in a press release. "With an 88 OpenCritic rating and 87 Metacritic score, **007 First Light** has been embraced by both critics and players alike, already establishing itself as one of 2026's most successful gaming releases."

The success is particularly notable given that a version for the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 is still slated for release later this summer, meaning the current sales figures represent only a partial picture of the game's potential reach. Early critical reception has been overwhelmingly positive, with IGN awarding it a 9/10 and praising its dedication to the Bond fantasy. Rhys Elliott, head of market analysis at Alinea Analytics, pointed out that **007 First Light** sold an estimated 500,000 copies on Steam alone, generating around $25 million in revenue on Valve's platform, which is a significant feat for a game often perceived as more console-centric.

## A Franchise Reinvigorated

The impressive sales figures and critical acclaim suggest that IO Interactive has not only honored the legacy of James Bond but has also revitalized the gaming side of the franchise. Many players have drawn comparisons to the studio's **Hitman** series, noting similarities in stealth mechanics and intricate level design, while also acknowledging that **007 First Light** carves out its own identity with a broader scope and a more personal narrative focus.

> "It's the latest example of a traditionally ‘console’’ game doing fantastic numbers on Steam," Elliott commented, adding that about a third of **007 First Light** players on Steam have also engaged with **Hitman**. This overlap indicates a strong crossover appeal and validates IO Interactive's commitment to crafting deep, engaging experiences that cater to a diverse player base, from hardcore fans of espionage thrillers to more casual gamers looking for a polished action-adventure.

## What's Next for Agent 007

With the initial launch proving to be a massive success, the focus now shifts to sustained engagement and future content. The upcoming release of the Nintendo Switch 2 version will undoubtedly bring in another wave of players. IO Interactive has a history of supporting their games post-launch, and fans are eagerly anticipating any news regarding post-release updates or potential expansions that could further deepen the **007 First Light** experience and continue to explore Bond's journey.

tr.title: 007 İlk Işık 24 Saatte 1,5 Milyon Satış Rakamına Ulaştı
tr.summary: IO Interactive'in yeni James Bond macerası 007 İlk Işık, ilk gününde 1,5 milyon kopya sattı. Bu başarıyla IO Interactive, şimdiye kadarki en hızlı satış rekorunu kırdı. Oyun, 27 Mayıs 2026'da PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S ve PC için yayınlandı.
tr.body:
IO Interactive'in yeni James Bond macerası **007 İlk Işık**, ilk 24 saat içinde 1,5 milyon kopya sattı. Bu satış rakamı, geliştiricinin şimdiye kadarki en hızlı satış rekorunu kırdı ve **Hitman** serisinin lansman günkü satışlarını geride bıraktı.

## Casusluk Oyunlarının Yeni Kralı
**007 İlk Işık**, 27 Mayıs 2026'da PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S ve PC için yayınlandı. Oyun, genç ve daha ham bir James Bond'un MI6 kariyerinin tehlikeli早 stagesında geçiyor. Bu köken hikayesi, Ian Fleming'in romanlarını ve ikonik film serisini yakalamayı amaçlıyor ve dünya çapındaki izleyicilerle rezonans yaratıyor.

> "1,5 milyon adetlik satış rakamı, **007 İlk Işık** için全球 entusiazmı yansıtıyor ve IO Interactive için önemli bir başarıyı temsil ediyor" diye açıkladı geliştirici. "88 OpenCritic puanı ve 87 Metacritic puanıyla **007 İlk Işık**, hem eleştirmenler hem de oyuncular tarafından benimsendi ve 2026'nın en başarılı oyun sürümlerinden biri olarak kendini kanıtladı."

Bu başarı, özellikle Nintendo Switch 2 sürümünün henüz yayınlanmamış olması nedeniyle dikkat çekici. Eleştirmenlerin ilk tepkisi çok olumlu ve IGN, oyunu 9/10 puanıyla ödüllendirdi. Alinea Analytics'in pazar analizi başkanı Rhys Elliott, **007 İlk Işık**'in yalnızca Steam'de 500.000 adet sattığını ve yaklaşık 25 milyon dolar gelir elde ettiğini belirtti.

## Yeniden Canlanan Bir Franchise
İlk günkü satış rakamı ve eleştirel beğeni, IO Interactive'in James Bond'un mirasını onurlandırdığını ve oyun tarafını canlandırdığını gösteriyor. Oyuncular, **Hitman** serisiyle benzerliklere dikkat çekiyorlar, ancak **007 İlk Işık**'in daha geniş bir kapsam ve daha kişisel bir anlatı odak noktasına sahip olduğunu kabul ediyorlar.

> "Bu, geleneksel olarak 'konsol' olarak görülen bir oyunun Steam'de harika rakamlar elde etmesinin son örneği" diye yorumladı Elliott. Steam'deki **007 İlk Işık** oyuncularının yaklaşık üçte biri **Hitman** serisiyle de ilgileniyor. Bu, güçlü bir kesişme cazibesi olduğunu ve IO Interactive'in derin, etkileyici deneyimler yaratma taahhüdünü doğruluyor.

## Ajan 007 İçin Sonraki Adımlar
İlk lansman büyük bir başarıyla sonuçlandığına göre, odak noktası şimdi sürdürülebilirlik ve gelecek içeriğe kayıyor. Nintendo Switch 2 sürümünün yayınlanmasıyla birlikte yeni bir oyuncu dalgası oluşacak. IO Interactive, oyunlarını yayınlandıktan sonra destekleme geçmişine sahip ve hayranlar, **007 İlk Işık** deneyimini derinleştirebilecek güncellemeler veya potansiyel genişletmeler hakkında haber bekliyor.

es.title: 007 Primero en la Oscuridad: Un Éxito Descomunal
es.summary: La nueva aventura de James Bond de IO Interactive ha roto todos los récords, vendiendo más de 1,5 millones de copias en sus primeras 24 horas. Este lanzamiento explosivo hace que sea la venta más rápida en la historia del desarrollador, incluso superando su exitosa serie Hitman.
es.body:
La industria de los juegos de espionaje tiene un nuevo rey, y su nombre es Bond. **007 Primero en la Oscuridad**, la última aventura del desarrollador danés IO Interactive, ha explotado desde el principio, vendiendo un asombroso 1,5 millones de copias en sus primeras 24 horas de lanzamiento. Este número no solo marca un récord personal para IO Interactive, sino que también establece un nuevo estándar, superando las ventas de lanzamiento de cualquier título en su exitosa serie **Hitman**.

El juego, que se lanzó oficialmente el 27 de mayo de 2026, para PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S y PC a través de Steam y la Tienda de Juegos Epic, presenta a los jugadores como un joven y más crudo James Bond que navega por las etapas tempranas de su carrera en MI6. Esta historia de origen, que busca capturar la esencia de las novelas de Ian Fleming y la icónica serie de películas, claramente ha golpeado una cuerda sensible con los audiencias de todo el mundo.

> "El logro de 1,5 millones de unidades vendidas en 24 horas refleja una entusiasmo global abrumador por **007 Primero en la Oscuridad** y representa un logro significativo para IO Interactive", declaró el desarrollador en un comunicado de prensa. "Con una calificación de 88 en OpenCritic y 87 en Metacritic, **007 Primero en la Oscuridad** ha sido abrazado tanto por críticos como por jugadores, ya estableciéndose como uno de los lanzamientos más exitosos de 2026 en el mundo de los juegos".

El éxito es particularmente notable dado que una versión para la próxima Nintendo Switch 2 aún está programada para su lanzamiento más tarde este verano, lo que significa que las cifras de ventas actuales representan solo una imagen parcial del potencial de alcance del juego. La recepción crítica temprana ha sido abrumadoramente positiva, con IGN otorgándole un 9/10 y elogiando su dedicación a la fantasía de Bond. Rhys Elliott, jefe de análisis de mercado en Alinea Analytics, destacó que **007 Primero en la Oscuridad** vendió una estimada de 500.000 copias en Steam sola, generando alrededor de $25 millones en ingresos en la plataforma de Valve, lo que es un logro significativo para un juego que a menudo se percibe como más centrado en consolas.

## Un Franchise Reinvigorado

Las impresionantes cifras de ventas y el elogio crítico sugieren que IO Interactive no solo ha honrado la legado de James Bond, sino que también ha revitalizado el lado de los juegos de la franquicia. Muchos jugadores han hecho comparaciones con la serie **Hitman** del estudio, destacando similitudes en mecánicas de sigilo y diseño de niveles intrincados, mientras también reconocen que **007 Primero en la Oscuridad** forja su propia identidad con un alcance más amplio y un enfoque narrativo más personal.

> "Es el último ejemplo de un juego tradicionalmente 'de consola' que hace números fantásticos en Steam", comentó Elliott, agregando que aproximadamente un tercio de los jugadores de **007 Primero en la Oscuridad** en Steam también se ha conectado con **Hitman**. Esto indica un atractivo crossover sólido y valida la compromiso de IO Interactive con la creación de experiencias profundas y atractivas que se adapten a una base de jugadores diversa, desde fanáticos acérrimos de thrillers de espionaje hasta jugadores más casuales que buscan una acción-aventura pulida.

## Próximos Pasos para el Agente 007

Con el lanzamiento inicial demostrando ser un éxito masivo, el enfoque ahora se centra en la participación sostenida y el contenido futuro. La próxima liberación de la versión de Nintendo Switch 2 sin duda traerá otra oleada de jugadores. IO Interactive tiene una historia de apoyar sus juegos después del lanzamiento, y los fanáticos están ansiosos por cualquier noticia sobre actualizaciones post-lanzamiento o potenciales expansiones que podrían profundizar aún más la experiencia de **007 Primero en la Oscuridad** y seguir explorando la aventura de Bond.

content_raw: 007 First Light has got off to a strong start, selling 1.5 million copies in its first 24 hours. It’s the fastest-selling game in developer IO Interactive’s history, which means it sold faster in its first 24 hours than any Hitman game. The impressive sales milestone was achieved without the aid of the Nintendo Switch 2 version, which is due out this summer. The James Bond adventure is also the highest rated IOI game ever, with an 87 on Metacritic. IGN’s 007 First Light review returned a 9/10. We said: “Demonstrably obsessed with bringing the Bond fantasy to life in a way no one has ever managed before, 007 First Light is the best Bond game I’ve ever played.” “The milestone of 1.5 million units sold in 24 hours reflects overwhelming global enthusiasm for 007 First Light and represents a significant achievement for IO Interactive,” the developer said. “With an 88 OpenCritic rating and 87 Metacritic score, 007 First Light has been embraced by both critics and players alike, already establishing itself as one of 2026's most successful gaming releases. The sales recorded across all platforms underscore the game's broad appeal and the successful execution of IO Interactive's vision to honor Bond's legacy in gaming.” Rhys Elliott, head of market analysis at Alinea Analytics, said 007 First Light had sold an estimated 500,000 copies on Steam alone, generating around $25 million in revenue on Valve’s platform. “The Steam performance really stood out for this one,” Elliott said. “It’s the latest example of a traditionally ‘console’’ game doing fantastic numbers on Steam.” About a third of 007 First Light players on Steam have also played Hitman, Elliott added. “For Amazon, which owns the Bond rights and licensed IOI to make this game, the early signs are bloody good,” he continued. “The franchise hasn’t had a quality adaptation in decades, and IOI has now delivered one that looks like a serious commercial proposition.” So, the first 24 hours are strong for 007, but it will be interesting to see how sales develop over the coming weeks and months. To put its performance into context, Crimson Desert sold 2 million in its first 24 hours back in March, and went on to sell 5 million in less than a month. Clearly, IOI hopes for enough success to continue 007 First Light’s story with a sequel . Indeed, the developer has said it wants to make a trilogy of James Bond games . Our 007 First Light Guide has all the Essential Tips and Tricks you need to survive your first assignments, plus 6 Tips for Mastering Stealth so you can stay out of sight. There are plenty of achievements to unlock and collectibles to get your hands on, so check our guide to All Collectible Locations to make sure you don’t miss out. For a helping hand with your missions, head to our in-progress Walkthrough , and our guide to all the Safe Combinations and Keypad Codes . Wesley is Director, News at IGN.
